brief.title: The Last Ferry Still Has a Light
brief.description: Urgent two-sector civilian escort with a sheltered respite. D major, B minor peril and G-major shelter. Ferry signal, first-sector answer, closing fire, sheltered crossing, second-sector climb, changed safe-channel return. Original manually authored melody and harmony; phrase map and source accompany this project.
